name: Kevin Mullin
stance: Supports AI safeguards and a House vote on them, and has raised the risk of AI being used to create bioweapons.

statements.text: The American people deserve to hear what actions this administration is taking to protect us against pandemics, deadly public health threats, & the risk of AI being used to create bioweapons.
We should be in DC lowering costs for American families and putting safeguards on AI—not getting sent home because @SpeakerJohnson doesn’t want a vote on them.
